long_biography.plain_text:
Rémy Epstein's only identified corporate appointment was at SFMI Charquemont. The French national based in Singapore served as an administrator alongside Marc and Charles Epstein. The company manufactured watch cases, bracelets and other precision metal components before broadening its work for luxury-goods clients during Epstein's time on its board.

Epstein left the board in 2021. The manufacturer later consolidated under the Swiss group Sycrilor Industries and expanded production in eastern France, but that later growth cannot be attributed to him. His role did not include a disclosed founding position, executive control or personal stake, and the mechanism behind his wealth remains unknown. It is therefore best described narrowly as board service, not ownership or day-to-day management of the wider group.

uncertainties.detail: The identity clears the threshold because exact name, French nationality and Singapore residence align between the owner record and French corporate notices. No other namesake found shares that full combination, although the public record remains sparse.

Registry-derived sources disagree on whether the SFMI administrator mandate began in 2005 or 2016. They agree that it ended in 2021, so the dossier proposes the role and end year but omits a start year.

The filings document a board seat, not share ownership, founder status or executive control. The shared Epstein surname among three directors does not prove kinship or inheritance. All four wealth classifications remain Unknown rather than importing a speculative manufacturing or family-wealth narrative.

Specialist reporting documents substantial SFMI-Sycrilor expansion after Epstein's 2021 departure. The longer biography explicitly separates that development from his mandate and does not credit it to him.
French corporate data provides only June 1948. No reliable source reviewed establishes an exact day or birthplace, so those fields remain blank.
